instruction: Enable airplane mode on your system to disable all wireless communications.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld environment because airplane mode is a system-level feature that controls hardware radio states. The OSWorld VM does not provide access to such low-level wireless management capabilities.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - airplane mode requires hardware-level wireless management unavailable in VM environment
